Pentagon report: US strikes killed 153 civilians in Yemen in 2025

A Pentagon assessment released in 2025 states that U.S. military operations killed 153 civilians and wounded 243. The report specifically details U.S. strikes targeting Houthis in Yemen. This assessment follows the dismantling of an office focused on mitigating unintended casualties. The Pentagon review covered three specific attacks, with 15 additional incidents still under review.
